file.description: MP4/MOV video; the content is validated, not the name or type.

commit.description: 40-64 hex git commit; null when not built from git.

DecisionBasisItem.description:
One input that the safety supervisor, FSM or controller actually evaluated for this tick's decision, with
the threshold it was compared against. Never contains evaluator truth.

effect.description: What the input drives when triggered.

input_frame_id.description: Equals the command's input_frame_id (same camera frame).
input_frame_id.title: Input Frame Id

key.description: Stable input name, e.g. image_obstacle_cue, frame_wall_age_s, target_speed_mps.
key.title: Key

threshold.description: Compared limit; null for informational inputs.
threshold.title: Threshold

triggered.description: True when this input currently drives `effect` (gate: condition holds).
triggered.title: Triggered

unit.description: SI unit of value/threshold (s, m, m/s, 1/m) or null.
unit.title: Unit

value.description: Evaluated value; null when the input was unavailable.
value.title: Value

model.description: Immutable identity of the model used for this job.

stage.description: Current pipeline stage name, e.g. probe/decode/encode.

ext.description: Accepted container extension, without a dot.

model.description: Model that produced the results, if learned.

decision_counts.description: Analytical decision state -> analyzed frame count.
decision_counts.title: Decision Counts

effective_analyzed_fps.description: Analyzed frames divided by total wall time.
effective_analyzed_fps.title: Effective Analyzed Fps

fps_avg.description: Average frame rate reported by the container.

rotation.description: Rotation in degrees applied for display.

width.description: Display width in pixels after rotation.
width.title: Width

JobVideo.title: JobVideo

Limits.description: Configured engineering limits (not measured server capacity).
Limits.title: Limits

LiveCommand.description: Simulator-only actuation computed by the deterministic controller; never sent to a physical vehicle.
LiveCommand.title: LiveCommand

LiveEgo.description: Ego localization telemetry from the simulator (allowed runtime input), ENU frame.
LiveEgo.title: LiveEgo

LiveManeuver.description:
What the simulated vehicle is doing on this tick: a deterministic description classified from the applied
command (after the safety supervisor) and ego telemetry (app.control.maneuver). It is not a controller.

accel_mps2.description: Longitudinal acceleration used for the label, m/s^2; null when no command applied.
accel_mps2.title: Accel Mps2

input_frame_id.description: Input frame id of the command this maneuver describes.
input_frame_id.title: Input Frame Id

primary.description: Display code; precedence HOLD > STOP > BRAKE > TURN_* > SLOW_DOWN > ACCELERATE > CRUISE.

signal_source.description: ego_telemetry_window: measured over the last 0.5 s of simulated time; command_model: LiteRoad pedal/bicycle model of the applied command (first ticks); none: no command (hold).

since_sim_time_s.description: Simulated time (s) at which the current primary began.
since_sim_time_s.title: Since Sim Time S

yaw_rate_radps.description: Yaw rate used for the label, rad/s (+ = left); null when no command applied.
yaw_rate_radps.title: Yaw Rate Radps

LiveManeuver.title: LiveManeuver

lane_points.description: Perceived lane points [[x, y], ...] in frame pixels.
lane_points.title: Lane Points

obstacle_boxes.description: Perceived obstacle boxes [[x1, y1, x2, y2], ...] in frame pixels.
obstacle_boxes.title: Obstacle Boxes

metrics.description: Prometheus metrics are exported (internal network only).
metrics.title: Metrics

live.description: Latest live state; null before the first frame.

outcome.description: Terminal outcome, e.g. arrived, stopped_operator, stopped_before_obstacle, stopped_camera_invalid, failed_collision, failed_out_of_bounds, failed_wall_time, failed_tick_limit.
outcome.title: Outcome

decision_basis.description: Inputs evaluated for this frame's decision, in pipeline order (frame checks, perception checks, ego/limits, FSM, controller, command).
decision_basis.title: Decision Basis

maneuver.description: Current maneuver; null for live states recorded before this field existed.
